scheme_totals = {
    'GlobalCard': 0,
    'NexPay': 0,
    'SwiftCharge': 0,
    'TransactPlus': 0
}

# Get all payments data (not just filtered to merchant) to properly calculate monthly stats
all_payments = load_payments()

# For each month in 2023
for month in range(1, 13):
    # Get full month stats for Rafa_AI (fraud/volume buckets are based on the entire month)
    month_stats = monthly_merchant_stats(all_payments, 'Rafa_AI', 2023, month)
    
    print(f"\nMonth {month}:")
    print(f"  Monthly fraud level: {month_stats['monthly_fraud_level_bucket']}")
    print(f"  Monthly volume: {month_stats['monthly_volume_bucket']}")
    print(f"  Transaction count: {len(month_stats['transactions'])}")
    
    # For each card scheme
    for scheme in scheme_totals.keys():
        # Filter transactions to this month and scheme
        month_scheme_txns = month_stats['transactions'][
            month_stats['transactions']['card_scheme'] == scheme
        ]
        
        if len(month_scheme_txns) > 0:
            # Calculate fees for this scheme in this month
            fees_by_rule = total_fees_paid(
                fees,
                month_scheme_txns,
                account_type=merchant_info['account_type'],
                mcc=merchant_info['merchant_category_code'],
                capture_delay=capture_delay_str,
                monthly_fraud_level=month_stats['monthly_fraud_level_bucket'],
                monthly_volume=month_stats['monthly_volume_bucket']
            )
            month_fees = sum(fees_by_rule.values())
            scheme_totals[scheme] += month_fees
            print(f"  {scheme}: {len(month_scheme_txns)} txns, fees: {month_fees:.2f}")
        else:
            print(f"  {scheme}: 0 txns")

print("\n\nTotal fees by scheme for 2023:")
for scheme, total in sorted(scheme_totals.items(), key=lambda x: x[1]):
    print(f"{scheme}: {total:.2f}")
